bills.title: Fair Work (Registered Organisations) Amendment (Withdrawal from Amalgamation) Bill 2024

name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-07-02.4.30) to the usual second reading motion (which is, "that the bill be read a second time" - parliamentary jargon for agreeing with the main idea of the bill). The amendment would have added the words below. ### Amendment text > *At the end of the motion, add ", but the Senate calls on the Government to allow any division of any amalgamated registered organisation to withdraw from the amalgamated organisation after a vote of members within the division, to ensure that unions remain true representatives of the workers they represent".*
